facts.fact: Connecting Africa reports that in July 2025 TTCL and Kenya's ICT Authority launched and implemented a terrestrial fibre link connecting Dar es Salaam in Tanzania to Mombasa in Kenya.
facts.system: Dar es Salaam-Mombasa terrestrial fibre link

systems.system: Dar es Salaam-Mombasa terrestrial fibre link

note: The Horizon Fiber corridor (Djibouti, Ethiopia, Sudan) does not name Tanzania.
